name: 10040 · New York, NY
findings: ZIP 10040 (New York) has 86 nonprofit organizations. 31 of them (36%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 24 organizations.
Arts and cultural organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (33% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 10040 (New York) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 10040 (New York) list public events in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 64% of the typical level).
